record_type_quote: Replication of genome‐wide association signals of type 2 diabetes in Han Chinese in a prospective cohort

targets.evidence_quote: A recent genome-wide association study for type 2 diabetes in Han Chinese identified several novel genetic variants. We investigated their associations with quantitative measures to explore the mechanism by which these variants influence glucose homoeostasis.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract reports associations but does not give the original study citation or a verdict comparing all retested signals to its findings.
